text: 创业板指半日跌超1%，江苏银行等多只银行股创历史新高。 恒指半日跌0.9%，恒生科技指数跌1.8%，智谱跌近9%，MINIMAX跌超6%。 美联储威廉姆斯：美联储在使通胀率回归目标方面“还有工作要做”。 报道：三星正就收购数据中心冷却系统公司Modine进行谈判。 中芯国际联合CEO赵海军：全年销售收入预计超120亿美元，同比增长近三成。 新华社：10月高频数据折射中国经济稳中向好态势。
text_en: The ChiNext Index fell more than 1% in the half-day session, while multiple bank stocks including Bank of Jiangsu hit record highs. The Hang Seng Index fell 0.9% in the half-day session, and the Hang Seng Tech Index fell 1.8%, with Zhipu down nearly 9% and MINIMAX down more than 6%. Fed's Williams: The Fed "still has work to do" in bringing inflation back to target. Report: Samsung is in talks to acquire data center cooling systems company Modine. SMIC Co-CEO Zhao Haijun: Full-year sales revenue is expected to exceed $12 billion, up nearly 30% year on year. Xinhua: October high-frequency data reflect China's economy maintaining a stable and improving trend.
